## Description

About Kiraan Pay

Kiraan Pay processes about RM 1.4 billion a month in DuitNow QR and card payments for 38,000 merchants across Malaysia. In March 2026 we launched Kiraan Settle, same-day settlement for SME merchants, and this year we are rebuilding the ledger behind it.

The role

You will join the Settlement team in Bangsar South and work on the services that pay merchants out on time.

Responsibilities

- Build and run Go services for merchant settlement and payouts on AWS.

- Make webhook delivery and settlement jobs idempotent, observable and safe to retry.

- Design PostgreSQL schemas for the new ledger and keep its queries fast.

- Share the on-call rotation for the Settlement services.

Requirements

- 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

- Go in production; Python is a plus.

- PostgreSQL and a message queue (SQS or Kafka).

- AWS and Docker.

- We want a self-starter who is comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have

- Payments or e-wallet domain experience.

- Redis caching.

What we offer

- Hybrid: 2 days a week in the Bangsar South office.

- RM 3,000 yearly learning budget, medical and dental cover, 16 days annual leave.
